configuration.scope: configuration_and_database; email recovery is a separate unconfigured dependency

treasury_reserves.source: read-only eth_chainId and eth_getBalance on https://mainnet.base.org; public treasury from /api/payments/config
treasury_reserves.qualification: Base native reserve only; above the existing 0.00005 ETH preflight floor. Token liabilities, Tempo reserves, worker freshness, pending payouts and total settlement fee bounds are not established. No transfer or signature.

settlement_worker.source: no fresh authorized worker-heartbeat observation in public readiness

payout_refund_anomalies.source: public completion counts do not establish absence of settlement anomalies

paid_canary.failure: Dedicated buyer lacked minimum 0.01 Base USDC; execution stopped before payment
paid_canary.qualification: Successful readiness/preflight workflow runs are not substituted for a complete fresh paid journey

dedicated_buyer_funding_observation.source: read-only public Base RPC; dedicated wallet identified by failed canary workflow
dedicated_buyer_funding_observation.qualification: Must be refreshed before any separately authorized live action; this is not a funded or completed purchase.

independent_customer_activity.qualification: Recorded volume is not independently attributable demand; unknown ownership is not independent
